summary.text: Josh Burns is the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 21, which his campaign says covers communities in Eaton and Ingham counties, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign is organized around three themes it calls "Life. Land. Liberty."

paragraphs.text: Burns advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026, receiving all 17,770 votes cast.
He launched his campaign on June 13, 2026, according to his campaign's press release, describing himself as a husband, father and lifelong Michigander.
His campaign website lists priorities including school choice, ending property taxes, protecting private property rights, and ending what it calls unconstitutional surveillance.

sources.title: Josh Burns for State Senate | Life. Land. Liberty.
